description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named ImmersiveActivity that manages immersive fullscreen UI behavior, including system UI visibility handling and gesture detection.

classes.name: ImmersiveActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that implements immersive mode toggling with gesture detection and system UI visibility management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI controls, and gesture detectors for immersive mode handling.

methods.name: onWindowFocusChanged
methods.description: Handles focus change events to trigger UI_HIDE delay or cancel based on focus state.

methods.name: hideSystemUI
methods.description: Sets system UI flags to hide navigation and status bars for immersive experience.

methods.name: showSystemUI
methods.description: Resets system UI flags to show navigation and status bars.

methods.name: delayedHide
methods.description: Schedules hiding of system UI after a specified delay.
